скрещивать книги одного типа для 
прокачки уровня

PrisonEvo: scroll effects are not Classic ancient-book coefficients.
SkyBlock OLD: its blacksmith and item destruction rules do not establish Classic rules.
VimeWorld Classic: deletion of its Plastolom is not deletion in Cristalix.
